note: Made from the release binary of gufo feat/gsq-rco (d6fc810, Nix, ROCm 7.2.3, AMD clang 22). The dense F16-tile WMMA route adds two IQ4_NL DenseF16GEMMKernel instantiations (108 and 112 B decode spills) and the kStageBf16 variant keeps its 460 B F16 staging under the new kQType template signature. The DecodeQuantSub16 low-bit cases inlined into the embedding lookups cost 32 B scratch each (outlining the switch was measured worse: call frames add their own scratch). The kernels in this file use scratch by design. Make the file again only after you decide that a new allowance is correct: python3 tools/ci/check-kernel-resources.py result/bin/gufo --write-baseline tools/ci/kernel-resources.json --note TEXT
